categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in computer and peripheral equipment manufacturing, including motherboards, graphics cards, laptops, and servers. It also engages in software services, electronic components manufacturing, wireless communication equipment, and IoT applications. Key product lines include gaming and AI-optimized motherboards, high-performance graphics cards, AI and cloud servers, 5G integrated solutions, and various computer peripherals.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced AI integration in hardware design, such as AI-assisted overclocking and PCB layout optimization. It employs innovative cooling technologies including liquid metal cooling and advanced water and air cooling systems for GPUs. Manufacturing processes include SMT, wave soldering, and rigorous quality control with ISO14001 and ISO9001 certifications. The company also develops modular AI server solutions with direct liquid cooling and immersion cooling technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Customers include gamers, professional content creators, AI developers, telecom operators, cloud service providers, and enterprises requiring high-performance computing. The company serves end markets such as gaming, AI training and inference, cloud computing, 5G infrastructure, industrial IoT, and automotive electronics. It also supports OEM and ODM clients globally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with sales and service networks across Western and Eastern Europe, China, Northeast and Southeast Asia, Australia, India, the Middle East, North and South America. Manufacturing facilities are primarily in Taiwan and China, with subsidiaries and offices in the US, Europe, India, Australia, and other regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on design, manufacturing, assembly, and distribution of computer hardware and servers. It sources key components like CPUs and GPUs from leading semiconductor suppliers (Intel, NVIDIA, AMD) and manages a sustainable supply chain with strict environmental and social governance standards.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include AI integration across product lines, development of high-performance AI and cloud servers, expansion of 5G and IoT applications, and continuous innovation in gaming hardware. R&D focuses on AI-assisted hardware optimization, advanced cooling solutions, modular AI server architectures, and energy-efficient designs. The company invests at least 3% of revenue annually in R&D to maintain technological leadership and sustainability.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of computer hardware including motherboards, graphics cards, laptops, servers, and peripherals. Additional income streams include software services, licensing agreements, and after-sales support. The company also issues convertible bonds and overseas depositary receipts as part of its financing activities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading global player in motherboard and graphics card markets, competing with major industry players such as ASUS, MSI, and other PC hardware manufacturers. It holds a strong position in AI server solutions and gaming peripherals, leveraging partnerships with Intel, NVIDIA, and AMD. Its brand AORUS is recognized for innovation and quality in the gaming segment.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported a revenue of approximately NT$265.1 billion in 2024, nearly doubling from the previous year, driven by strong AI server sales. Net profit more than doubled to NT$10.76 billion. Total assets increased by 35.5% to NT$111.3 billion, with equity up 45.2%. The company maintains a healthy liquidity position and continues to invest in capital expenditures and R&D to support growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes innovation-driven, AI-integrated high-performance computing solutions with superior cooling technologies and user-friendly designs. It offers a comprehensive ecosystem from gaming to enterprise AI servers, ensuring privacy, security, and energy efficiency. Its commitment to sustainability, including green manufacturing and supply chain management, enhances brand trust and competitive advantage.
